LESSON: KUANDIKA 12.3.1 HOTUBA YA KUSHAWISHI

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: KISWAHILI
Strand: Strand 12
Topic 12.3: Kuandika 12.3.1 Hotuba ya Kushawishi

SEHEMU 1: KARIBU

Habari! Leo tutajifunza kuhusu Kuandika 12.3.1 Hotuba ya Kushawishi. Soma, angalia mifano, fanya mazoezi, kisha jaribu jaribio la marekebisho.

SEHEMU 2: UTAPATA KUJUA NINI

Mwisho wa somo hili, utaweza:

1. kueleza maana ya hotuba ya kushawishi ili kuitofautisha na aina nyingine za hotuba
2. kujadili vipengele vya kuzingatia katika uandishi wa hotuba ya kushawishi
3. kuandika hotuba ya kushawishi akizingatia vipengele vifaavyo

SEHEMU 3: JIFUNZE HATUA KWA HATUA

1. kueleza maana ya hotuba ya kushawishi ili kuitofautisha na aina nyingine za hotuba
   In simple words: practise until you can kueleza maana ya hotuba ya kushawishi ili kuitofautisha na aina nyingine za hotuba. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. kujadili vipengele vya kuzingatia katika uandishi wa hotuba ya kushawishi
   In simple words: practise until you can kujadili vipengele vya kuzingatia katika uandishi wa hotuba ya kushawishi. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. kuandika hotuba ya kushawishi akizingatia vipengele vifaavyo
   In simple words: practise until you can kuandika hotuba ya kushawishi akizingatia vipengele vifaavyo. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SEHEMU 4: MIFANO

Example 1: Talk about Kuandika 12.3.1 Hotuba ya Kushawishi using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SEHEMU 5: JARIBU HIVI

1. Underline two new ideas about Kuandika 12.3.1 Hotuba ya Kushawishi in the examples.
2. Explain Kuandika 12.3.1 Hotuba ya Kushawishi to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Kuandika 12.3.1 Hotuba ya Kushawishi.
4. Show that you can: kueleza maana ya hotuba ya kushawishi ili kuitofautisha na aina nyingine za hotuba

SEHEMU 6: KAZI YA KUFANYA

1. Write five sentences about Kuandika 12.3.1 Hotuba ya Kushawishi using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Kuandika 12.3.1 Hotuba ya Kushawishi important for a Grade 9 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SEHEMU: KUMBUKA

1. kueleza maana ya hotuba ya kushawishi ili kuitofautisha na aina nyingine za hotuba
2. kujadili vipengele vya kuzingatia katika uandishi wa hotuba ya kushawishi
3. kuandika hotuba ya kushawishi akizingatia vipengele vifaavyo

Sasa fanya Jaribio la Marekebisho. Angalia Majibu baada tu ya kumaliza.
